description.fun: Elgyem had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert about 50 years ago, and rumours link it to a UFO crash there. If it stands near a TV, strange scenery appears on the screen, said to be from its home. It squeezes foes' brains with psychic power to give them unbearable headaches, and most alien sightings are really just people mistaking Elgyem. Its name comes from 'LGM', little green men.
description.guide: Elgyem is a Psychic-type Pokémon that looks like a small alien, said to have appeared about 50 years ago. It attacks with strong psychic power. It evolves into Beheeyem.
description.tagline: A little grey alien that turned up after a UFO crash.

description.fun: Beheeyem talks by flashing its red, green and yellow fingertips in patterns nobody has decoded, perhaps a nod to the alien light show in Close Encounters of the Third Kind. It can rewrite the memories of its opponents, so you may already have had yours rewritten. It's sometimes seen drifting over wheat fields, and Dubwool are said to go missing whenever it visits a farm. Its name comes from 'BEM', bug-eyed monster.
description.guide: Beheeyem is the evolved form of Elgyem, a Psychic-type alien-like Pokémon that can control and rewrite its opponents' memories. It communicates by flashing its three coloured fingers.
description.tagline: A memory-wiping alien that signals with flashing fingertips.
